invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of execute(), which is expected to be non-null.
The input records list must not be null for upsert actions in typical data management flows.
The instantTime parameter usually represents a commit or action time and should not be null or empty.
The method returns HoodieWriteMetadata, whose getWriteStatuses should yield a non-null list.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required to perform the upsert operation.
